idea-plugin.name: OAuthLint
idea-plugin.description:
OAuthLint catches OAuth, OIDC, JWT, MCP, session, cookie, and CORS anti-patterns that AI coding tools frequently produce, and surfaces them as native inline annotations while you edit. This includes a dedicated MCP server-auth pack (token pass-through, RFC 8707 audience binding, unauthenticated transports, tool-handler SSRF) for the TypeScript and Python MCP SDKs.

It scans the current file on open and on save and highlights each finding with a gutter marker and a tooltip that carries the rule id, the explanation, and a link to the rule documentation. Severity is mapped to the IDE's own error, warning, and weak-warning levels.

OAuthLint is fully self-contained. The rule pack ships inside the plugin and the Opengrep scan engine is downloaded once and verified against a pinned SHA-256 checksum. There is nothing else to install.

Supported languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, C#/.NET, PHP, Ruby, and Kotlin, activated automatically wherever the matching language support is present. The 250+ rule pack adds framework-aware coverage (ASP.NET Core, Gin/Echo/Fiber, Hono + better-auth, FastAPI, Ktor, Laravel/Socialite, Rails/Devise/OmniAuth/Doorkeeper) alongside the MCP server-auth pack.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.0

  • New languages: PHP, Ruby, and Kotlin. The pack now spans nine languages, with framework-aware rules for Laravel/Socialite (PHP), Rails/Devise/OmniAuth/Doorkeeper (Ruby), and Ktor (Kotlin).
  • More framework packs. ASP.NET Core (C#), Gin/Echo/Fiber (Go), Hono + better-auth (TS), and FastAPI (Python).
  • 250+ rules total; the extraction cache key was bumped so the new rules load on upgrade.

0.2.1

  • MCP server-auth coverage. Catches the OAuth 2.1 mistakes Model Context Protocol servers ship: token pass-through (confused deputy), missing RFC 8707 audience binding, unauthenticated transports, and tool-handler SSRF, for the official TypeScript and Python MCP SDKs.
  • Rule pack refreshed; the extraction cache key was bumped so the new rules load on upgrade.

Full release notes: github.com/Auspeo/oauthlint/releases
